name: Deathguard Linnea
summary: At a roadside post in southeastern Tirisfal, Deathguard Linnea watches the roads between Brill and the eastern borders. Her unit guards against the Scarlet Crusade and the Scourge still in the wilds. Travelers sometimes join them on patrol.

sections.title: A Vigil on the Roadside
sections.body: Southeast of Brill, Deathguard Linnea guards a fortified post. The Forsaken defend their young realm from Scarlet Crusade infiltrators and Scourge still prowling the wilderness. Linnea and her fellow guards patrol the road and share reports with Magistrate Sevren in Brill. Their watch keeps the eastern road toward the Bulwark secure.

faq.answer: Linnea serves in the Deathguard, the Forsaken force that defends their territory. She guards a waystation southeast of Brill in Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: Why does she need help patrolling?
faq.answer: Forsaken forces are spread thin across Tirisfal Glades. Linnea relies on travelers and rising champions to clear nearby threats, keeping the way safe for messengers and supply runners traveling to and from Brill.

angles.text: As a Forsaken newly risen from Deathknell, you can help Linnea guard the waystation and protect your kingdom's borders.
As an ally of the Forsaken traveling through Tirisfal Glades, you can help Linnea secure the outlying roads against hostile forces.
